7f8b1b038829.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
7f8b1b038829.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT e.*,
		CASE WHEN e."day" = u.first_seen::DATE THEN 'new' WHEN e."day" > u.first_seen::DATE THEN 'returning' END AS us,
		CASE WHEN e."day" = g.first_seen::DATE THEN 'new' WHEN e."day" > g.first_seen::DATE THEN 'returning' END AS gs
	FROM events e
	LEFT JOIN identities u ON u.project_id = 4 AND u.kind = 'user' AND u.id = e.user_id
	LEFT JOIN identities g ON g.project_id = 4 AND g.kind = 'group' AND g.id = e.group_id
	WHERE e."project_id" = 4 AND e."day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10') SELECT us, count(DISTINCT "user_id") FROM s WHERE us IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT e.*,
		CASE WHEN e."day" = u.first_seen::DATE THEN 'new' WHEN e."day" > u.first_seen::DATE THEN 'returning' END AS us,
		CASE WHEN e."day" = g.first_seen::DATE THEN 'new' WHEN e."day" > g.first_seen::DATE THEN 'returning' END AS gs
	FROM events e
	LEFT JOIN identities u ON u.project_id = 4 AND u.kind = 'user' AND u.id = e.user_id
	LEFT JOIN identities g ON g.project_id = 4 AND g.kind = 'group' AND g.id = e.group_id
	WHERE e."project_id" = 4 AND e."day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-10') , p AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT "group_id") AS g, count(*) AS c FROM s WHERE "family" = 'product' AND gs = 'new'),
				q AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT e."group_id") AS g, count(*) AS c FROM events e
					JOIN identities i ON i.project_id = 4 AND i.kind = 'group' AND i.id = e.group_id
					WHERE e."project_id" = 4 AND e."family" = 'product' AND e."day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-22' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
					AND e."day" = i.first_seen::DATE)
				SELECT p.g, p.c, q.g, q.c FROM p, q
